name: piper-markdown-review
description: Enhanced Markdown preview, HTML/PDF, TOC and WeChat publishing. Markdown 增强预览、导出、目录与公众号排版。

commands.title: Piper Markdown: Insert Table of Contents
Piper Markdown: Set Image Upload Token
Piper Markdown: Clear Image Upload Token

piperMarkdown.uploadUrl.description: Multipart upload endpoint, e.g. https://images.example/api/public-images. HTTP is allowed only for loopback addresses.

piperMarkdown.ttl.description: Piper only: requested temporary-image lifetime. Other providers use their own lifecycle rules. 仅 Piper：临时图片有效期；其他图床由各自存储策略控制。

piperMarkdown.fileField.description: Piper/Generic multipart file field; Qiniu always uses file. Piper/通用图床文件字段；七牛固定使用 file。

piperMarkdown.urlField.description: Piper/Generic response URL path, such as data.url; Qiniu uses key. Piper/通用图床响应 URL 字段，七牛使用 key。

piperMarkdown.fontSize.description: WeChat body font size in pixels.

piperMarkdown.previewWidth.description: Maximum content width of the WeChat layout preview in pixels.

piperMarkdown.scrollSync.description: Synchronize the WeChat layout preview and its source editor.

piperWechat.uploadUrl.description: Multipart upload endpoint, e.g. https://images.example/api/public-images. HTTP is allowed only for loopback addresses.
piperWechat.uploadUrl.deprecationMessage: Use piperMarkdown.uploadUrl; explicit legacy values remain a fallback.

piperWechat.ttl.description: Piper only: requested temporary-image lifetime. Other providers use their own lifecycle rules. 仅 Piper：临时图片有效期；其他图床由各自存储策略控制。
piperWechat.ttl.deprecationMessage: Use piperMarkdown.ttl; explicit legacy values remain a fallback.

piperWechat.fileField.description: Piper/Generic multipart file field; Qiniu always uses file. Piper/通用图床文件字段；七牛固定使用 file。
piperWechat.fileField.deprecationMessage: Use piperMarkdown.fileField; explicit legacy values remain a fallback.

piperWechat.urlField.description: Piper/Generic response URL path, such as data.url; Qiniu uses key. Piper/通用图床响应 URL 字段，七牛使用 key。
piperWechat.urlField.deprecationMessage: Use piperMarkdown.urlField; explicit legacy values remain a fallback.

piperWechat.fontSize.description: WeChat body font size in pixels.
piperWechat.fontSize.deprecationMessage: Use piperMarkdown.fontSize; explicit legacy values remain a fallback.

piperMarkdown.wechatSkipLeadingH1.description: Omit a leading H1 from WeChat layout/copy/export only; source and enhanced exports stay intact. 公众号排版、复制及导出时忽略开头的一级标题，不修改源文或增强导出。

piperMarkdown.imageHostProvider.description: Image host protocol / 图床协议。Piper preserves the original private host API; Generic supports configurable multipart APIs; Qiniu uses an upload token.
enumDescriptions: Piper temporary image host / Piper 临时图床
Configurable multipart API / 通用 multipart 图床
Qiniu direct upload / 七牛云直传

piperMarkdown.uploadAuthMode.description: Generic host authentication / 通用图床鉴权方式。Credentials are stored with Set Image Upload Token, never in settings.

piperMarkdown.uploadHeaderName.description: Generic credential header name / 通用图床凭据请求头名称。

piperMarkdown.uploadHeaderPrefix.description: Prefix before the stored credential; empty for a raw API token / 凭据前缀，原始 Token 可留空。

piperMarkdown.uploadTokenField.description: Generic credential form field / 通用图床凭据表单字段名。

piperMarkdown.uploadHeaders.description: Generic non-secret request headers. Put credentials in SecretStorage instead / 通用图床非敏感请求头，凭据请存入 SecretStorage。

piperMarkdown.uploadFields.description: Generic non-secret multipart fields / 通用图床非敏感 multipart 表单字段。

piperMarkdown.publicBaseUrl.description: Qiniu public HTTPS image base URL, e.g. https://images.example/ / 七牛云公开 HTTPS 图片域名。

piperMarkdown.qiniuKeyPrefix.description: Optional Qiniu object key directory prefix / 七牛云对象键目录前缀。

piperMarkdown.wechatIncludeTOC.description: Automatically add an article TOC to WeChat output. Explicit source TOC markers remain respected. 自动添加公众号正文目录；保留原文中的目录标记。

piperMarkdown.wechatPreset.description: WeChat publication style preset / 公众号样式预设。

piperMarkdown.wechatLineHeight.description: WeChat body line height / 公众号正文行距。

piperMarkdown.wechatAccentColor.description: WeChat accent color in six-digit hex / 公众号主题色（六位十六进制）。

piperMarkdown.wechatHeadingStyle.description: WeChat heading decoration / 公众号标题装饰。

piperMarkdown.enhanced.protocolsWhiteLis.default: http://, https://, atom://, file://, mailto:, tel:

piperMarkdown.enhanced.tikzRendererPath.description: Absolute path to a separately installed node-tikzjax module. User scope only; workspace and Markdown cannot choose an executable. Empty uses ~/.local/share/piper-markdown-tools/node_modules/node-tikzjax. Install manually with npm install --prefix ~/.local/share/piper-markdown-tools node-tikzjax@1.0.5. The extension does not download or include this optional tool.
